trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Customer states the issue with the order and requests a refund.
steps.text: வணக்கம், என்னோட order ORD-40003 earphone defective ஆ இருக்கு. எனக்கு refund பண்ணனும். App ல எப்படி பண்றது னு புரியல.

steps.purpose: Agent greets and asks for verification details.
steps.text: வணக்கம். கவலை படாதீங்க, நான் உங்களுக்கு help பண்றேன். உங்க details verify பண்ண, உங்க registered name மற்றும் pincode சொல்லுங்க?

steps.purpose: Customer provides name and pincode.
Agent calls verify_customer_identity tool.
Tool returns verification success.
Agent confirms verification and asks for exact defect details.
steps.text: நன்றி முருகன். உங்க details verify ஆகிடுச்சு. நீங்க earphone defective னு சொன்னீங்க, அது என்ன problem னு கொஞ்சம் detail ஆ சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Customer explains the defect and reiterates refund request.
steps.text: அது ஒரு side sound கேக்கல. நான் app ல return பண்ண try பண்ணேன், ஆனா அது புரியல. Refund வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Agent asks customer to wait while checking eligibility.
steps.text: புரியுது sir. நான் உங்க order return பண்ண முடியுமா னு check பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிடம் line ல இருங்க.

steps.purpose: Agent calls check_return_eligibility tool.
Tool returns eligible but replacement_only.
Agent informs customer about replacement only policy.
steps.text: Sir, உங்க order check பண்ணேன். இது replacement_only category ல வருது. அதாவது, உங்களுக்கு refund கிடைக்காது, ஆனா புது earphone தருவோம்.

steps.purpose: Customer asks for clarification on replacement.
steps.text: Replacement னா என்ன? எனக்கு காசு திரும்ப கிடைக்காதா?

steps.purpose: Agent explains replacement in simple terms.
steps.text: ஆமா sir, காசு திரும்ப தர முடியாது. பழைய defective earphone ஆ வாங்கிட்டு, அதே model ல புது earphone தருவாங்க. இது தான் policy.

steps.purpose: Customer confirms understanding of replacement.
steps.text: ஓ, அப்போ பழைய earphone ஆ எடுத்துட்டு புதுசு தருவாங்களா?

steps.purpose: Agent asks for preferred pickup day.
steps.text: Exact ஆ sir. இப்போ நாம் பழைய earphone ஆ வாங்க ஒரு pickup schedule பண்ணனும். எந்த நாளுக்கு arrange பண்ண வசதியா இருக்கும்?

steps.purpose: Customer suggests tomorrow, but STT error occurs.
Agent clarifies the corrupted STT input.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும், நீங்க நாளை pickup பண்ண சொல்றீங்களா?

steps.purpose: Customer confirms tomorrow.
steps.text: ஆமா, tomorrow தான் சொன்னேன். நாளை வரட்டும்.

steps.purpose: Agent acknowledges and initiates pickup scheduling.
steps.text: சரி sir. Tomorrow கு நான் pickup போட்றேன். ஒரு நிமிடம்.

steps.purpose: Agent calls schedule_pickup tool.
Tool returns scheduled pickup details.
Agent provides pickup ID and courier details.
steps.text: Sir, உங்களுக்கு நாளை pickup schedule ஆகிடுச்சு. Pickup ID PU-908. Ekart courier ல இருந்து வருவாங்க.

steps.purpose: Customer asks when the new earphone will arrive.
steps.text: சரி. அப்போ புது earphone எப்போ வரும்?

steps.purpose: Agent clarifies pickup must happen first, without forward guarantees.
steps.text: முதல்ல உங்க defective earphone pickup ஆகும் sir. அதுக்கு அப்றம் தான் replacement process ஆகும். நீங்க earphone ஆ box ல போட்டு ready ஆ வெச்சுக்கோங்க.

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully implements the workflow, business rules, and persona behaviors, demonstrating excellent handling of the 'replacement_only' edge case and grounding constraints. issues.detail: The IR step s16 indicates that an STT error occurs, and the assistant in e17 asks for clarification as if the input was unclear. However, the trace for e16 contains perfectly clear, uncorrupted text ('நாளை வரலாமா?') with no STT error applied to the model_visible_text, making the agent's clarification unprompted and unnatural.
issues.repair_instruction: Introduce a plausible STT corruption in the `model_visible_text` of e16 (e.g., 'நாளை வராமா' or similar) and populate the `stt_error_type`, `clean_span`, and `corrupted_span` fields so that the assistant's clarification in e17 is justified.

verifications.summary: The conversation correctly implements the business rules and tool grounding variants, and the persona is well-represented. However, there is a discrepancy between the intended STT error in the IR and the actual trace, where perfectly clear text is met with a clarification request. A surface repair to corrupt the STT input in e16 will fix this.
